description: This Java source file defines a final class 'DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl' which is a builder for creating responses and events related to deleting feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested classes for response and event factories, and methods to generate specific response types and events.
